_about: REF-008 back-room fixture map for ART. Plan frame = REFERENCES_INDEX 1.2 (feet, origin Retail NW outer corner, +x east, +y south). Positions are mapped into the Working Plan V5 / graybox room shells (A011 interior dims do not sum to the building width, GAP-125). pos_ft = footprint centre [x, y]; null = not placeable, see gap. size_ft = [w, d, h]: w along +x when rot = 0, along +y when rot = 90. faces = compass direction the front/opening faces. Doors: pos is the centre of the opening on the wall line, size = [width, leaf thickness, height]. Confidence High/Med/Low as REFERENCES_INDEX. Sources: wall2_/wall1_RrCc = CCTV Camera Wall 2 / Camera Wall tiles; FOH_still / BOH_still = the 2026-10-29 desk stills; chat_* = CCTV views Nolan pasted into the REF-008 session 2026-10-29 (not in the repo); A011 = References/TI A011 vector; TI = REFERENCES_INDEX 6. contents = what a fixture holds (store facts only, e.g. DEC-050); never inventory data. propsDoor = DOORS.json id of the door this fixture props open (it stands inside that leaf's closing sweep on purpose; swing checks skip it while the door is proppedOpen). FOH is staff-only: customers never enter, the budtender fetches (DEC-050). Excluded by rule: camera positions, access-control hardware, alarm items, safe interiors, screen contents, one office wall screen, the hall keypad (a blank panel only, DEC-062), and (DEC-051) any safe, cash-equipment or camera-system specifics: generic props only.
